Please see the attached screenshots. I have included additional ones to highlight that the exported results do not match the filtered results.

In the first 2 screenshots, there should be results, but the exported file show 0 results.

In the 3rd screenshot, the filtered result count is 7, however the exported file shows all search results instead.

when you get results - you can export. If you use a filter without ““ - it exports only the filtered selection. But if you add a filter with ““ such as “345” - it filters, but then the export returns 0 results. I had a few people try it and I tried another production system, and it was the same. The expected result would be the export of the filtered results in the ““

Jason SRE supporting notes:

I have re-tested again viaTJXC via PROD

 

shows 39 rows

 

notification shows 39 rows

excel fie has 39 rows

is it possible to ask what values she is using to fill in the following: ?

I am suspecting some permission issue but i have replicated cindy’s permission and teams and it works for me.
